scope: Google Ads stored/live goal value and scheduled KPI/Benchmark renderer characterization; existing V1-128, with V1-106 report availability dependency.
classification: Pre-change reproduction, not fixed-flow or production acceptance.
findings: Current and original-audit resolvers return the saved Google Ads value without resolving current Ads metrics. Synthetic cases demonstrate both false-positive and false-negative alert decisions relative to the displayed current value.
Current and original-audit KPI/Benchmark report builders render the stored 137 while the actual page resolver returns 10.
Current and original-audit KPI/Benchmark report formatters render null as zero.
Current page CPC is unavailable with no clicks, but a previously stored zero remains eligible for the tested below-threshold alert decision.
preservationBoundary: Current-value inputs are user-editable and save payloads do not distinguish automatic prefill from manual overrides. A correction must preserve intentional manual values and must not guess the origin of existing stored numbers.
limits: No application code, persisted data, provider, browser or email access.
Synthetic goals and captured renderer text, not real PDF layout or delivery validation.
No actual live false alert or report occurrence is claimed.
Add/edit/delete goal handlers, full scheduled execution, other templates and report snapshot lifecycle remain unverified in this packet.
Existing audit assignments are unchanged; these are not new finding IDs or evidence of a regression introduced by the latest deployment.
